$comment: MODEL-INT-001 — SHA256 pins for local model artifacts. A silently swapped model artifact silently invalidates every tuned guardrail threshold and golden eval, so the artifact identity is checked at download and at load. Entries with sha256=null are UNPINNED and are reported as such rather than being treated as verified: fabricating a hash would be worse than admitting we do not have one. Add a pin by downloading the artifact, running `python -m modules.model_integrity --hash <path>`, and recording the result here together with the date and where it was obtained.
